# middmonitor_host_group (Resource)

A group of hosts. Alert correlation is scoped to a host and its group, so the grouping is structural rather than cosmetic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "middmonitor_host_group" "frontends" {
  name         = "frontends"
  display_name = "Front-end servers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Technical name, unique per organization.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable label shown in the UI.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Host group ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import middmonitor_host_group.example 42
```
